support.faq.payment.q: When and how do I pay?
support.faq.payment.a: You pay nothing on the site. You send the request, we call to confirm availability and delivery, then you receive a secure payment link by SMS or email. Payment only happens after our call.
support.faq.deposit.a: For most medical aids, no. A deposit applies only to a few higher-value products (electric wheelchairs, for example). It is stated clearly on the product page and returned in full at the end of the rental.
support.faq.deliveryCost.a: It depends on the area and the product. We confirm it by phone before payment, with no surprises. For many products it is free on rentals of 30 days or more, and for beds, assembly in the room is always included.
support.faq.hygiene.a: Yes. Every medical aid is sanitised, checked and certified after each rental. It reaches you sanitised and ready to use.
support.faq.extend.a: Yes, one phone call is enough: extend whenever you like and pay only for the extra days.
support.faq.unsuitable.q: What if the product is not right?
support.faq.unsuitable.a: Call us: we will swap it for something more suitable or collect it. We can also help you choose before you order.
home.faq.delivery.a: We deliver and assemble it ourselves, in Rome and Florence, usually within 24–48 hours of the order. At the end of the rental we come and collect the medical aid: delivery and collection are already included in the rate.
home.faq.minimum.q: What is the minimum rental period?
home.faq.minimum.a: It starts at one week. If you need it longer, one phone call is enough: the extension starts immediately, with nothing new to sign.
home.faq.hygiene.a: Yes. Every medical aid is sanitised, checked and adjusted before each delivery. They are all CE-certified devices with documented maintenance.
home.faq.prescription.q: Do I need a doctor’s prescription?
home.faq.prescription.a: No, renting requires no prescription. If you have a claim open with the Italian health service, we will help you work out what you are entitled to and what to do next.
home.faq.payment.a: Online by card, or on delivery. The rate is per day and covers everything: no hidden deposit, no cost appearing later.
home.faq.earlyReturn.q: Can I return the medical aid early?
home.faq.earlyReturn.a: Yes: call us and we will arrange an early collection. You pay only for the rental days your chosen plan actually covers.

home.showcase.heading: Featured products
home.testimonial.1.text: I ordered it one evening for my mother and by the following afternoon it was already in her room, assembled and adjusted. Before they left they talked me through every control, unhurried.
home.testimonial.2.text: I moved the collection dates twice and it was never a problem: the same voice, the same patience. When you are caring for an elderly parent, that is worth more than any discount.
home.testimonial.3.text: Five minutes on the phone, with no complicated sign-up. The rollator arrived in Florence the next day, already adjusted to my father’s height.
home.testimonial.4.text: I compared three services before choosing: here the rate is per day, with delivery and collection included, and no surprise cost appeared at the end.
home.testimonial.5.text: The wheelchair arrived sanitised, tyres inflated and brakes adjusted: it looked like it had just left the shop. At collection they were punctual to the minute.
home.testimonial.6.text: After the operation I needed an electric bed for six weeks only. Delivery, assembly and collection included: when the rental ended they took it away, and that was that.
